notes: Reconciled from blind labelers A and B. Both gave the same 12 outer-skin pairs, and nothing was left in dispute after checking. Real mesh scan of part 38172000 rev 01 (t ~1.44 mm, plane rms 0.01-0.04 mm, included angles 88.8-92.7 deg, scan blotches, inner skin of lip 13 mostly missing). Part frame: z = plate-1 normal, x toward step wall 5/6. The part is a Z-step tray. The top plate 1/2 has three 90 deg down-lips: 10/12 (-y edge), 9/11 (+y edge) and 13 (far -x end). At the +x edge the plate folds 90 deg down into step wall 5/6 (~39 mm), which folds 90 deg into lower flange 3/4. Flange 3/4 has an outer 90 deg down-lip 7/8 and two 90 deg end lips, 18/20 (+y) and 19/21 (-y). Two lanced tabs stand up 90 deg from the outer edges of the two arrow-shaped slots: A (14/17 at y ~-73) and B (15/16 at y ~+99). The last ~6.5 mm of each tab is folded ~29 deg outward about a vertical axis (22/24 and 23/25). The reconciler checked all prep PNGs, 14 of its own z-buffered views, 24 tab-end close-ups, raw-resolution horizontal slices (z=-1..12.5) and 24 sections across both end portions, plus sections at every flange corner. Raw horizontal slices show both tab skins bending continuously, with a radius, into the angled end at every height from z=2 to z=12.5, so that is a formed fold. The end portions are not folded from the plate. Next to the kink (x ~48.5-50.5) the end-portion bottom is a free cut edge at z ~+1 with a relief gap to the plate edge. Further out it meets the plate at square corners with no bend radius (contact or scan merge), unlike the ~1.5 mm radius at every real fold here. Corners 9-12/5-6, 18-21/7-8 and 9-12/13 are open gaps between separate closed lip ends, not folds. The x=115/130 sections show 18-21 folding from 3/4 with a rounded arc. Patch 26 is a facet of the inner arc of lip 13. Every unsegmented point lies within 2.7 mm of a patch (arcs, edges and hole rims only). Mixed-skin and inner-twin candidates duplicate these 12. The prep's [2,16] for tab B is the inner/mixed choice: sections show the outer skin of tab B is 15 (the slot side).
